title: Edge Addeleting
statement: The task is to maximize the distance between vertices 1 and n of a tree (n, m up to 5·10^5) after m operations, each adding edge (1, v_i) and deleting one cycle edge. Added edges all touch vertex 1, so the final path is one edge from 1 plus an original path avoiding 1; one BFS from n with vertex 1 blocked gives max(original distance, dist(v_i, n)+1) over reached v_i.
